family: The single total weighted-selection certificate-prefix family defined at every length in proof.md Sections1--2 and family.py. Enumerate all prime2<=k<N, r=ceil((N-k)/k) with r>=3 and k>r+1, and2<=t<r. Use d=H+max(T,floor(F_r))+1 when k>=2r+1 and2k>=(t+1)^2, where H=r(r+3)/2,T=(t-1)k-t(t+1)/2+1,h=ceil(2r/(t+1)),F_r=r(2k-2r-1+h)/(2(t+1)); otherwise use d_old=H+max(T,floor(U/(t+1)))+1, U=rk-r(r+1)/2. Require B=t(t+3)/2<=d<N-k and select the lexicographically least(4k+8d-4B-3,k,t), with zero output if none exists. Read the paid degree-k polynomial prefix, reject invalid prefixes, and evaluate the descending-power order-t BK symmetric payload polynomial with zero padding.
theorem: This one fixed total language is in uniform P, hence NP with empty witnesses. For every actual integer length N, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-L_N, with L_N the exact selected loss or4N when no pair is admissible. Every sufficiently large integer length is admissible and L_N=O(N^(4/5))=o(N). The guarded weighted marked-subset selection theorem supplies degree>=B on every dimension-d affine payload space and the retained full-B2 theorem supplies4m-8d+4B+3. Therefore for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(F_N)>=(4-epsilon)N for every integer N>=N_epsilon in the full Li-Yang B2 model.
